definitions.explanation: An official notice warning of danger or an emergency situation, such as weather warnings or emergency alerts.

examples.japanese: {警報|けいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
{大雨|おおあめ}{警報|けいほう}。
⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧{警報|けいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A volcanic eruption warning was issued.

notes:
{警報|けいほう} is an official warning or alert issued by authorities, especially regarding weather or natural disasters. It indicates a higher level of danger than ⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧ (advisory).

TYPES:
- {大雨|おおあめ}{警報|けいほう}: heavy rain warning
- {暴風|ぼうふう}{警報|けいほう}: storm warning
- ⟦{津波|つなみ}→津波：05064_tsunami⟧{警報|けいほう}: tsunami warning
- ⟦{噴火|ふんか}→噴火：00045_funka⟧{警報|けいほう}: volcanic eruption warning
- {洪水|こうずい}{警報|けいほう}: flood warning

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {警報|けいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧/⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: a warning is issued
- {警報|けいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}される→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧: a warning is lifted
- {警報|けいほう}{発令中|はつれいちゅう}: warning in effect

SEVERITY SCALE (weather):
⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧ (advisory) → {警報|けいほう} (warning) → {特別|とくべつ}{警報|けいほう} (emergency warning)
